proxy.name: infath-out-rjhi
proxy.description: infath-out-rjhi — Al Rajhi Bank (RJHI) B2B/VA services proxy (dev). Routes 12 conditional flows to RJHI backend paths via a Target Server, transforming JSON↔XML where the backend needs XML.

policies.name: RF-EmptyRequestBody
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<RaiseFault async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="RF-EmptyRequestBody">
    <DisplayName>RF-EmptyRequestBody</DisplayName>
    <FaultResponse>
        <Set>
            <Headers>
                <Header name="Content-Type">application/json</Header>
            </Headers>
            <StatusCode>400</StatusCode>
            <ReasonPhrase>Bad Request</ReasonPhrase>
            <Payload contentType="application/json"><![CDATA[{"error":{"code":"EMPTY_REQUEST_BODY","message":"A request body is required for {proxy.pathsuffix}."}}]]></Payload>
        </Set>
    </FaultResponse>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</RaiseFault>

policies.name: J2X-RequestBody
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<JSONToXML async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="J2X-RequestBody">
    <DisplayName>J2X-RequestBody</DisplayName>
    <Source>request</Source>
    <OutputVariable>request</OutputVariable>
    <Options>
        <RecognizeNumber>true</RecognizeNumber>
        <RecognizeBoolean>true</RecognizeBoolean>
        <RecognizeNull>true</RecognizeNull>
    </Options>
</JSONToXML>

policies.name: X2J-ResponseBody
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<XMLToJSON async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="X2J-ResponseBody">
    <DisplayName>X2J-ResponseBody</DisplayName>
    <Source>response</Source>
    <OutputVariable>response</OutputVariable>
    <Options>
        <RecognizeNumber>true</RecognizeNumber>
        <RecognizeBoolean>true</RecognizeBoolean>
        <RecognizeNull>true</RecognizeNull>
        <NullValue>NULL</NullValue>
        <AttributeBlockName>#attrs</AttributeBlockName>
        <AttributePrefix>@</AttributePrefix>
    </Options>
</XMLToJSON>

policies.name: AM-Set-BankTransfer-Path
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Set-BankTransfer-Path">
    <DisplayName>AM-Set-BankTransfer-Path</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Template>/B2BService/epayments/paymentMT101</Template>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>false</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: EV-BankTransfer
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<ExtractVariables async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="EV-BankTransfer">
    <DisplayName>EV-BankTransfer</DisplayName>
    <Source>request</Source>
    <VariablePrefix>extracted</VariablePrefix>
    <JSONPayload>
        <Variable name="BankTransfer_EncryptedPayload">
            <JSONPath>$.EncryptedPayload</JSONPath>
        </Variable>
    </JSONPayload>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</ExtractVariables>

policies.name: AM-BankTransfer-UnwrapPayload
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-BankTransfer-UnwrapPayload">
    <DisplayName>AM-BankTransfer-UnwrapPayload</DisplayName>
    <Set>
        <Payload contentType="text/xml">{extracted.BankTransfer_EncryptedPayload}</Payload>
    </Set>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>
